_about: Redstone rules and common circuits. A redstone tick = 2 game ticks = 0.1 s.

signal.fact: Power travels up to 15 blocks of dust, losing 1 per block. Repeaters refresh it to 15 and add 1-4 redstone ticks of delay; they also stop backflow.

comparator.fact: Compares or subtracts signals and reads containers (fuller = stronger signal).

observer.fact: Sends a short pulse when the block in front changes. Used for flying machines and crop farms.

pistons.fact: Push up to 12 blocks; sticky pistons pull back one. Obsidian, bedrock and some blocks can't be moved. Quasi-connectivity: pistons, droppers and dispensers also turn on from power to the space above them (Java only).

hoppers.fact: Move 2.5 items per second; a powered hopper stops.

common_circuits.fact: Clock (repeater loop or observer clock), T flip-flop (toggle), pulse extender, item sorter (hopper with comparator), hidden piston doors, TNT cannons (water to protect the cannon), flying machines (slime blocks, observers and pistons).

traps.fact: Pressure plates or tripwires trigger TNT, dispensers with lava or arrows, or pistons that drop players into pits; observers detect blocks broken or placed; sculk sensors detect sounds at range.
